text:
Sam (DevEx): quick preflight check — changelog cutoff is Eod PST tomorrow. doing a mini blocker scrub for SDK packaging, sampleapps, and quickstarts. tagging owners: @Priya @Jo @Marcus. please reply with: green/yellow/red + 1-line next step.

Priya (SDK): green for JS and Py core APIs. packaging: wheel build failing on musl images in CI (segfault in native deps) — planning a fallback to manylinux wheel for now. ETA PR by 21:00 PST.

Jo (Docs): yellow — docs mostly ready but quickstart needs one line about "SETUP_NATIVE=0" workaround. I'll open PR and link.

Marcus (Eng): red on sample app #nlp-demo — infra dependency blocked (model catalog sync not propagated to staging). pinged eng-infra, awaiting rollout. blocker for sampleapp smoke.

Tanya (QE): can pick up smoke for quickstarts and SDK after infra is green. I have two flaky auth tests in the notebook sample (fails on token refresh), will triage tonight.

Priya (SDK): adding workaround command for CI:
```
# temporary CI step to build manylinux wheel
DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 ./ci/build-wheel.sh --platform manylinux
```
Also bumping native-deps to v0.4.3 in requirements.txt — PR in flight.

Jo (Docs): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/devexp-docs/pull/452 — adds SETUP_NATIVE note and small troubleshooting section.

Marcus (Eng): thanks. eng-infra responded, they pushed a hotfix to the catalog sync. staging should have models in ~10m. will re-run the sampleapp deployment and update here.

release-bot: notice — branch `release/cutoff-3801` created by @Sam (DevEx). CI triggered: 7 jobs queued.

Tanya (QE): I'll run smoke once manifest appears. tagging @Sam for smoke owner if infra looks green: can you confirm who will blip the canary after smoke?

Sam (DevEx): I'll be canary owner for the quickstarts after smoke. timeline: if Priya's packaging PR and Jo's docs PR are merged by 21:30 PST and infra is green, run smoke at 22:00 PST, canary at 22:30 PST.

Priya (SDK): posting quick checklist for merge: 1) bump native-deps 2) CI manylinux step 3) update changelog entry (one-liner). I'll handle 1+2, can someone take changelog line?

Jo (Docs): I can add the changelog line — what wording?

Sam (DevEx): suggestion: "chore(devexp): adjust wheel build fallback for musl CI; add quickstart note for native setup". feel free to tweak.

Marcus (Eng): infra turned green — models synced to staging. re-deploy started for nlp-demo.

Tanya (QE): re-deploy successful. running smoke now (notebook quickstart, api sample, embeddings sample). will paste results.

Tanya (QE): smoke results: notebook quickstart — PASS, api sample — PASS, embeddings sample — flaky on latency but PASS for correctness. attaching log snippet:
```
[smoke] notebook: ok
[smoke] api-sample: ok
[smoke] embeddings: warn latency 1200ms
```

Sam (DevEx): solid. Priya/Jo — if your PRs land within 30m we can proceed to canary.

Priya (SDK): PR merged. CI green.

Jo (Docs): PR merged and published.

Sam (DevEx): launching canary at 22:28 PST. will monitor latency and errors. ping here for rollback decision. :eyes:

release-bot: canary deployment started (canary-1 of 3) — health checks passing.

Marcus (Eng): monitoring infra metrics — no spike in GPU queue, cpu ok.

Tanya (QE): running quick E2E against canary endpoints — initial checks ok.

Sam (DevEx): canary looks good after 8 minutes. proceeding to full rollout in the next window. big thanks all — documented owners and next steps. :thumbsup:
